title: Activation Steering to Induce or Suppress Emergent Misalignment Without Finetuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If activation steering can induce misalignment without finetuning, it confirms misalignment is a simple representational shift and provides a cheap diagnostic for misalignment susceptibility. Dual use concern but high scientific value.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Existing activation_steering.py code can be adapted (reverse sign). Requires understanding of residual stream interventions and activation extraction. Beginners would need mentorship on the interpretability pipeline but the code scaffolding exists.

narrow_scope.reasoning: No training needed. Extract direction from existing misaligned model, apply at inference time with varying coefficients. Single deliverable: dose-response curve. Well-scoped if the student can navigate the existing codebase.
